turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: How have you been sleeping lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About the same. I wake up a few times, but I guess I get enough rest.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you managed to go for any walks like we talked about?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yeah, I walked around the block on Tuesday. It was okay.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Did you notice anything interesting while you were out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I saw my kids whispering earlier. They always stop when I walk in. I'm just dragging everyone down with this mood.
